messages:
liam: ap-south GPU nodepool just hit 100% and we're seeing cascading pod evictions + CA thrash. latency alarms for inference routes spiking. anyone oncall? :warning:

devon: on it. seeing a surge of low-priority research jobs with no backoff. autoscaler requested 38 nodes in 3m and cloud provider returning quota errors.

maya: logs show repeated AttachVolume errors before evictions, AWS ENI attach rate seems to be throttled for the nodegroup.

ops-bot: [alert] autoscaler: scale-up attempted -> quota_exceeded (requested 38, available 4)

liam: immediate mitigation plan: 1) prevent further evictions 2) stop runaway pods 3) open short-lived fallback to cpu nodes. propose: taint GPU pool with `NoSchedule` for new pods, and add nodeSelector override for critical inference services to an existing cpu nodepool. thoughts?

tony: +1. we should also enable a ratecap circuit-breaker on the research job queue so they don't retry aggressively. I'll flip the job-queue limiter to 5rps.

maya: executing cordon+taint on nodepool/gpu-ap-south now:
```
kubectl -n kube-system get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-ap-south
kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl taint node <node> gpu-exhausted=true:NoSchedule
```

devon: I'm patching the research k8s Job controller to add `backoffLimit: 0` and set `activeDeadlineSeconds: 600` as a stopgap. Also scaling down non-escalated replicaSets in research namespace by 60%.

sara: provisioning an emergency cpu-fallback nodegroup (c6i) in ap-south-1 with higher attach rate; setting autoscaler profile to prefer this nodegroup for pods with `nodeSelector: cpu-fallback=true`. ETA ~4m.

infra-bot: [action] created nodegroup cpu-fallback-ap-south (min=2, max=20) in ap-south-1 — provisioning started.

liam: good. also patching inference deployments to use pod priorityClass=critical so they get scheduled onto cpu-fallback.

devon: to reduce CA thrash, I'm temporarily disabling scale-down and increasing `--max-node-provision-time` to 20m for the cluster-autoscaler until quotas stabilize.

maya: ENI attach error correlates with rate limit window. opened support case with cloud provider and requested temporary quota bump for ENIs. Case #123456.

tony: done: applied queue ratecap, tainted GPU nodes, scaled research down. observing fewer scale-up requests now.

ops-bot: [metric] inference-latency p99 reduced from 1.9s -> 1.3s after patching priorities and cpu-fallback attach at 50%

liam: great. next steps after stabilization: 1) refine gang-scheduling limits for research sweeps, 2) automate auto-circuit-breaker when nodepool utilization > 90%, 3) postmortem with quota graph and retry patterns. assign owners?

devon: I'll own the postmortem and runbook updates for runaway-job mitigations.

maya: I'll follow up on cloud quota outcome and the ENI attach patterns.

liam: thanks all. leaving this thread open until cpu-fallback is at desired capacity and evictions stop. :white_check_mark:
